get.summary: Everyone's answers for a night, in the order they answered. Players without an answer are not listed

put.summary:
Set a player's answer: "all_in" or "fold". Players answer for themselves; results keepers and admins for
anyone. Repeating the same answer changes nothing

get.summary: Admin changes, newest first. Filter with subject_type (Night, Player, Season, Place) and subject_id. Admins

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.summary: Log in with a session cookie (the website). Call GET /sanctum/csrf-cookie first
Create an API token for another client, such as a phone app

get.summary: The logged-in user, their player and what they may do

put.summary:
Change the logged-in user's own password. Needs the current password.
The user's other API tokens stop working

get.summary: The holiday table, by name. Admins can add archived=1 to see archived holidays too
The holidays of one year, in date order, including the ones cancelled for that year and the extras

post.summary: Cancel a table holiday for one year, or add an extra holiday that year

Record a past Main Event in one step, saved as finished ("Importar"). Admins. A finished season takes it
too
Enter or correct the result of a Main Event night ("Finalizar"). Results keepers and admins

Schedule a night in a season ("Adicionar"). Results keepers and admins. An extra night is not a round and may
share its date. A Main Event night is always extra, a season takes one, and only an admin schedules it

get.summary:
The season's nights, oldest first, with results: the rounds, the extra nights and the Main Event night.
Accepts status and updated_since filters

post.summary: Record a past night in one step, saved as finished ("Importar"). Results keepers and admins

Schedule several nights at once, all or none: the dates chosen in the season planner (admins). Each night gets
the season's default place. Refuses dates that already have a night in the season

patch.summary:
"Editar evento": change a night's place or description, or whether it is extra. Results keepers and admins
for a scheduled night; only admins for an open or finished one

post.summary: "Remarcar": change a scheduled night's date and time. Results keepers and admins
"Cancelar": cancel a scheduled night. It is archived, not deleted. Results keepers and admins
Open a scheduled night ("Abrir"). Only one night per season can be open

Enter or correct a night's results ("Finalizar"). Points are calculated from the pot. A Main Event night is
finished with POST nights/{night}/main-event-result

get.summary:
A night's dashboard: the participants with what they bought and paid, the pot and the time chip worked out
from it, and the open night's partial result. Made to be asked for again every few seconds

patch.summary:
Set a participant's marks; leave out the ones that stay. Any call makes the player a participant and, on
an open night, answers ALL IN for them: with no mark it only confirms the player

delete.summary: "Remover do evento": take a participant with no marks and no rebuys off the night

post.summary:
"+ Rebuy": record one more rebuy of a player. Send the number of rebuys the player had on the screen: when
it is no longer that number, someone else recorded the same rebuy and nothing is added

patch.summary: Mark a rebuy as paid or not paid

delete.summary: Remove a rebuy recorded by mistake

put.summary: "Dono da casa": say who owns the house where the night is played, or null for nobody
Put a player in one scoring position of the open night's partial result, or null to empty it
Set the Main Event pot of the open night by hand, or null for the season's share of the pot

"Manual": type the pot or the time chip of the open night, for a night that does not record every player's
payments; leave out the one that stays. Null takes a typed amount away. The dashboard still answers the
ones it works out

get.summary:
A night's partial result ("Resultado parcial"): what the players recorded so far. When nobody saved one, and
on a night that is not open, every field is empty

put.summary:
Save the partial result of an open night. Active players, results keepers and admins. It replaces all of
it: send null for an amount that is not known and leave out the positions that are empty

post.summary:
Send a password link to the email of an account, for a user who forgot the password.
Some addresses never get a link: the answer then tells the user to ask an admin

email.description: The address the link went to, with most of its name hidden: "m•••@example.com".

get.summary: The account behind a password link, when the link still works

post.summary: Set a new password with a password link. The link stops working and every login of the account ends

get.summary:
Players, each with the memo: active first, then inactive, by nickname ignoring capitals and accents. Archived
players only for admins with archived=1.
Filters: status (active|inactive), search (nickname or name), updated_since (ISO 8601)

post.summary: Add a first-timer by nickname only, e.g. from the results form. Results keepers and admins

get.summary: One player, with the memo

patch.summary:
Update a player. Admins change everything: the profile, the memo, active or inactive, archived or restored.
A player changes their own nickname, name, email and birthday

get.summary:
A player's thumbnail, as an image file. 404 when the player has none.
The answer can be cached for a year: put the player's thumbnail_version in the URL (?v=...)

A player's photo, larger than the thumbnail, as an image file. 404 when the player has none.
The answer can be cached for a year: put the player's photo_version in the URL (?v=...)

post.summary:
Set a player's photo and thumbnail from one picture, replacing the ones there were. Admins, and the player
themself. The server cuts the picture from the middle to 3 wide by 4 tall and makes both images as JPEG:
the photo with 600 x 800 pixels and the thumbnail with 180 x 240.
Send the picture as multipart/form-data in `image`: JPEG, PNG or WebP, 8 MB at most, and between 180 and
4096 pixels a side

delete.summary: Remove a player's photo and thumbnail together. Admins, and the player themself

put.summary: Create the player's login, or change its username, role or password. Returns the player with its login

get.summary:
One player's statistics over the finished nights: totals, finishing positions, each season, each night
scored and the running total.
With `season`, one season; without it, every season that is not archived
All seasons, newest first. Accepts updated_since (ISO 8601) for syncing
The current season: the newest one that is open and not finished

Every season that is not archived, newest first, each with the first ten of its standings.
When the tenth place is shared, tied_not_shown counts the players left out
Standings of the season, highest total first. Players with the same total share a rank

Suggested dates for a new night: the next three regular weekdays, at the regular time, from today.
Dates that already have a night are left out. Only suggestions; any date can be scheduled

post.summary: "What if" standings for an imagined next night. Nothing is saved

get.summary:
The season planner (admins): the regular nights between two dates, every N weeks, with holidays, emendas and
the Carnival weekend left out and the reason given. Dates that already have a night are marked taken.
With `count`, the plan stops at the night that completes that many (the rounds left). Nothing is saved;
schedule the chosen dates with POST seasons/{season}/nights/batch

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day of the plan (Y-m-d), at most about 18 months later.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Stop after this many planned nights, even before `to`: the rounds the season still needs.

get.summary:
The season calendar: its nights (with the winner of finished ones, the ALL IN count and the user's answer)
and the regular nights left out because of a holiday, an emenda or Carnival, in date order

Statistics of the finished nights: top ten lists and the leaders' running totals.
With `season`, one season; without it, every season that is not archived

count.description: How many rebuys the player had on the screen when "+ Rebuy" was tapped.

AttendanceAnswer.description: A player's answer for a night: coming ("ALL IN") or not ("FOLD").
AttendanceAnswer.title: AttendanceAnswer

answered_by.description: Who set the answer, when it was not the player: a results keeper or admin.

is_extra.description: Outside the season's calendar: not a round. Always true for a Main Event.

winner.description: Nickname of the 1st place, for finished nights. A Main Event has one too.

all_in_count.description: How many players answered ALL IN.

skip_reason.description: Set for regular nights left out: holiday, bridge (the day before is a holiday) or carnival.

password.description: The same limits as a password set by an admin (SavePlayerLoginRequest).
The same limits as a password set by an admin (SavePlayerLoginRequest).

device_name.description: A name for the device or app, shown when managing tokens.

player_ids.description: Player ids in finishing order, the 1st place first. At least one, and nobody twice.

pot.description: The night's pot, as a decimal string such as "840.00".

main_event_pot.description:
The money set aside for the Main Event, as a decimal string. "0" when there is none. Required,
unless the site has no Main Event pot: then it is not kept.

time_chip.description:
The money set aside for the year party (rebuys and late arrivals), as a decimal string. "0" when
there is none. Required, unless the site has no time chip: then it is not kept.

holiday_id.description: Set when a table holiday is cancelled for the year.

date.description: Set for an extra holiday that year (Y-m-d).

month.description: Fixed-date holidays: month and day. Null for Easter-based ones.

easter_offset.description: Easter-based holidays: days after Easter Sunday (Sexta-feira Santa is −2). Null for fixed dates.

first_year.description: Only from / until these years, when set.

HolidayScope.description: Where a holiday applies. All three kinds count as a day with no night.
HolidayScope.title: HolidayScope

player_ids.description: Player ids in finishing order, the 1st place first. At least one, and nobody twice.

main_event_pot.description: Required, unless the site has no Main Event pot: then it is not kept.

time_chip.description: Required, unless the site has no time chip: then it is not kept.

is_extra.description: An extra night is outside the season's calendar: not a round, and it may share its date.

count.description: How many finished Main Events count.

podiums.description: Players by times in the first three of a Main Event (`count`).

buy_in_paid.description: Whether the player paid the buy-in.

time_chip.description: Whether the player arrived late and owes a time chip. False also unmarks it as paid. Refused on a site without the time chip.

time_chip_paid.description: Whether the player paid that time chip. True also marks it as owed. Refused on a site without the time chip.

can_edit.description: Whether this user may change this night's dashboard. The API still checks every request.

prices.description:
What the night charges, as decimal strings: a price the season does not have is "0.00". `fixed`
says the prices were copied when the night was finished, so the season no longer changes them.

anyOf.description: The owner of the house where the night is played.

players.description:
The participants, by name. `buy_in` is the price that applies to the player. `owed`, `paid` and
`pending` add up the buy-in, the rebuys and the time chips of the player.

positions.description: The positions of the open night's partial result filled so far. Empty once the night is finished.

main_event_pot.description: The Main Event pot set by hand on the open night. Null: the suggested one is in use.

suggested_main_event_pot.description: The season's share of the pot (the typed one, when there is one), rounded to a whole unit. Null when the season sets none.

totals.description: The amounts worked out from the participants. `time_chip` is null on a site without the time chip.

manual.description:
The pot and the time chip set by hand on an open night ("Manual"), which stand in
for the ones in `totals`. Null for an amount that was not typed.

recorded.description: The amounts a finished night was finished with. Null while the night is open.

positions.description: The positions filled so far; the others are left out.

saved_by.description: Who saved it last. Null when nobody saved one yet.

type.description: What the result is. regular: a pot and points. main_event: the order of the players, with no pot.

is_extra.description: Outside the season's calendar: not a round, and it may share its date. Always true for a Main Event.

main_event_positions.description: The result of a Main Event night: its players in finishing order. Empty on any other night.

username.description: The account whose password the link changes.

taken.description: The season already has a night on this date.

night_id.description: The existing night on a taken date.

skip_reason.description: Why the date is left out, or null.

anyOf.description:
holiday, bridge (the day before is a holiday) or carnival. | | |---| | `holiday`
The night itself is a holiday. | | `bridge`
The day before is a holiday ("emenda"): a long weekend. | | `carnival`
The night falls in the Carnival weekend. |

thumbnail_version.description:
Null when the player has no thumbnail. The image is at /players/{id}/thumbnail; add ?v=<this value>

photo_version.description: The same for the larger photo, at /players/{id}/photo.

email.description: Contact details only for admins and the player themself.

login.description: Site access, only for admins: null when the player has no login.

memo.description: A free text about the player. Everyone logged in reads it; only admins write it.

thumbnail_version.description:
Null when the player has no thumbnail. The image is at /players/{id}/thumbnail; add ?v=<this value>
to the URL, because the answer is cached for a year.

photo_version.description: The same for the larger photo, at /players/{id}/photo.

email.description: Contact details only for admins and the player themself.

login.description: Site access, only for admins: null when the player has no login.

rank.description: The player's position by total points among everyone who scored. Null when the player did not.

nights_scored.description: On how many nights the player scored.

wins.description: How many nights the player won.

positions.description: How often the player finished in each scoring position, first place first. Positions never reached have count 0.

seasons.description: The player's line in the standings of each season in which they scored, newest first.

results.description: The nights on which the player scored, newest first.

points_progress.description: The player's running total: per night in a season, per season otherwise.

steps.description: Oldest first. `night_id` and `starts_at` are null when the step is a season.

points.description: The total after each step, as decimal strings.

rank.description: Lines with the same value share a rank (1, 2, 2, 4).

count.description: Set in lists that count: nights scored, times in a position, nights at a place.

amount.description: Set in lists of points or money: a decimal string.

position.description: The finishing position, in a "Posição" list.

rows.description: At most ten lines, highest first.

tied_not_shown.description: Lines left out that are tied with the last line.

login.description: The username or the email of the account.

month.description: Fixed-date holidays: month and day. Leave out for Easter-based ones.

easter_offset.description: Easter-based holidays: days after Easter Sunday (Sexta-feira Santa is −2, Corpus Christi 60).

pot.description: The night's pot so far, as a decimal string such as "840.00", or null when not known.

main_event_pot.description: The Main Event pot so far, as a decimal string, or null when not known.

memo.description: Shown on the player's page. Admins only.

buy_in.description: What a player pays to enter a night. On a site with the night dashboard, a night's money is worked out from the season's money settings.

rebuy_value.description: A rebuy's price, without the time chip it may also charge. Required when the season has rebuys.

time_chip_value.description: The price of one time chip. Refused on a site without the time chip.

main_event_pot_percent.description: The share of a night's pot that the night dashboard suggests as its Main Event pot, in whole percent. Refused on a site without the Main Event pot.

rounds.description: How many nights ("rodadas") the season has; 26 by default. Scheduling more is allowed, with a warning.
